sentences.en: It was debatable whether the dirt she viewed was mindless.
sentences.zh: 她看到的那些污垢是否有意义是有争议的。

sentences.en: Accept it or not, this is a debatable view.
sentences.zh: 不管你接不接受，这是一个有争议的观点。

sentences.en: Your opinion about video gamers being blind to problems is debatable.
sentences.zh: 你认为视频游戏玩家对问题视而不见的看法是有疑问的。

senses.zh: 可争辩的,成问题的,未定的
